# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Location and Privacy

Determines which privacy-sensitive data apps may request, such as location and speech.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — SC - Device Security - D - Location and Privacy |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Location_and_Privacy.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Location_and_Privacy.json) |

> The only own setting (letappsactivatewithvoiceabovelock) is in Login and Lock Screen at OIB and is therefore not lost.
